description: IoT HackBot: A collection of Claude Skills and custom tooling for hybrid IoT pentesting

written.description: Works an IoT device from three sides: its companion Android app, its hardware debug and serial interfaces, and the network it sits on. Each hardware skill ships a small Python helper instead of assuming the tool is installed.

alive.last_commit_message:
jtagprobe skill: add to plugin + document --jlink-binary fallback

Add the jtagprobe feature to the branch as one unit: SKILL.md, the backing
tool (tools/iothackbot/jtagprobe.py + core/jtagprobe_core.py), the bin/
wrapper, and the README entry. Optimization review found the skill already
high quality (all 6 flags and defaults validated against source, all code
blocks pass bash -n); the one content change documents the existing
--jlink-binary flag so JLinkExe need not be on PATH.
